answer: Require each agent to post a stake and earn trust only through verified work over time, so reputation grows slowly, like a juniper, rather than being claimed instantly. A new identity starts with no voting power and must complete audited tasks; its record is examined from several angles, as light through a prism, so copied work is exposed and the stake is slashed. Like a lantern, an identity gains influence only once its history is checked. An attacker must fund and maintain a costly history for every fake identity, making a swarm more expensive than the influence it buys.
